item.title: Threatening Emails Led Investigators Back to Chris Coleman
item.description: Before Sheri Coleman and her two sons were murdered in May 2009, Chris Coleman reported threats against his family. Investigators traced the threatening emails to his own laptop, supporting the prosecution’s case that he had invented an outside suspect. He was convicted of all three murders.

item.title: Joanne Dennehy Killed Three Men in Just Ten Days
item.description: In March 2013, Joanne Dennehy murdered three men in Peterborough before attempting to kill two more men in Hereford. The case traces her crimes, the efforts to conceal the victims’ bodies, and the guilty pleas that led to a whole-life prison sentence.

item.title: Anne Hamilton Byrne Raised Children on a Cult Lie
item.description: Anne Hamilton-Byrne led the Australian cult The Family, where children obtained through adoption scams were taught to obey her as a divine figure. Survivors described isolation, abuse, and enforced conformity behind their matching clothes and blond hair, exposing the control beneath the group’s carefully arranged appearance.

item.title: Text Messages Exposed Abuse by Shanda Vander Ark
item.description: Text messages between Shanda Vander Ark and her older son revealed how they treated 15-year-old Timothy Ferguson before his death in July 2022. The case exposed prolonged abuse and starvation, leading to Vander Ark’s murder conviction and a sentence of life without parole.

item.title: A Missing License Plate Led Police to Joel Rifkin
item.description: In June 1993, a missing license plate drew police attention to Joel Rifkin’s pickup truck. Inside, officers discovered the body of 22-year-old Tiffany Bresciani. His arrest led to confessions to 17 killings, exposing a series of murders that had gone undetected for years.

item.title: How Robert Bardo Tracked Down Rebecca Schaeffer
item.description: Robert Bardo paid a private investigator to find actress Rebecca Schaeffer’s home address before killing her in 1989. The Vile Eye examines his fixation, the escalation from fan letters to stalking, and the choices that culminated in her murder.
